newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo's Tricon sets Louisville for HQ.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo's Tricon sets Louisville for HQ.

text.p: Tricon Global Restaurants Inc, PepsiCo Inc's soon-to-be-spun-off restaurant unit, said on Thursday that its corporate headquarters would be in Louisville.
Tricon said in a news release that it will build an 83,000-square-foot building next to its KFC restaurant support center, creating 250 jobs.
Tricon will consist of PepsiCo's KFC, Pizza Hut and Taco Bell operations. It is to be spun off to PepsiCo shareholders later this year.
Tricon said its Pizza Hut and international restaurant support centers will remain in Dallas, and its Taco Bell support center will remain in Irvine, Calif.
